statement: Magha's ruling planet (Vimshottari dasha lord) is Ketu; its presiding deity is the Pitris (ancestral spirits), symbolized by a throne. It is traditionally associated with ancestry and authority — power inherited or earned through lineage and legacy.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
